ShortDescription.Value: Hover a road and click: a working pedestrian bridge appears, at the right height, joined to the sidewalks.

Publish.LongDescription:
Hover a road and click. Footbridge Builder puts a working pedestrian bridge over it: the right height, ramps that fit, joined to the sidewalks. No other mods needed.
Built for game version **1.6.***.
### Credits
Parts of the build code are adapted from **Placemaker** by jackwrichards (GPL-3.0), which in turn credits ParkManager and Grid Road Generator. Inspired by kianzarrin's Automatic Pedestrian Bridge Builder for the first game. Footbridge Builder is GPL-3.0 too; the full source is on GitHub (link on this page).
